name: bottasker-tasky
description: Tasky helps build and operate BotTasker apps through the BotTasker MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Create and operate BotTasker apps with Tasky and MCP tools.
interface.longDescription: Tasky Assistant gives Codex guided skills for creating apps, Base de datos modules (Data Hub service), catalogs, products, carts, useful dashboards for tracking and control, boards with per-user push/sound alerts, secure sharing and automation buttons, Meta-compatible WhatsApp templates, AI agents, subagents, dynamic tools, workflows, and operational modules through the BotTasker external MCP.
defaultPrompt: Create a BotTasker app with data models and workflows.
Design a Base de datos (Data Hub) and dashboard in BotTasker.
Build an AI agent with subagents and dynamically discovered tools in BotTasker.
